about: What this member said on the floor, from the Congressional Record: their own words only, and of those the sentences that name an alignment question's phrases or make a commitment. Written by npm run record:collect (scripts/collect-record.mjs).
name: Daniel Meuser

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: DISMANTLE FOREIGN SCAM SYNDICATES ACT
statements.title: DISMANTLE FOREIGN SCAM SYNDICATES ACT
sentences: After many hearings, roundtables, and meetings with private industry, law enforcement, and regulators, we released a report on our findings and proposed solutions.

Mr. Speaker, of the many nefarious findings, it is evident that most of the scams that Americans encounter are not run by criminals here at home but by sophisticated transnational criminal organizations in places like Southeast Asia.
This includes using additional tools like extradition and mandatory minimums for penalties.
I certainly urge all of my colleagues here in the House to support this important bill.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: RETIREMENT FAIRNESS FOR CHARITIES AND EDUCATIONAL INSTITUTIONS ACT OF 2025
statements.title: RETIREMENT FAIRNESS FOR CHARITIES AND EDUCATIONAL INSTITUTIONS ACT OF 2025
sentences: Specifically, I want to focus on how this bill will impact thousands of working families in Pennsylvania's Ninth Congressional District.
I certainly urge my colleagues to support it again.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: SALUTING OUR VETERANS
statements.title: SALUTING OUR VETERANS
sentences: I urge my colleagues to continue the fight to ensure we live up to the promise made to all of those who served.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: PROVIDING FOR CONSIDERATION OF H.R. 9576, NATIONAL FRAUD ENFORCEMENT DIVISION ACT OF 2026; PROVIDING FOR CONSIDERATION OF H.R. 10326, PREVENTING RIP-OFFS AND OBTAIN
statements.title: PROVIDING FOR CONSIDERATION OF H.R. 9576, NATIONAL FRAUD ENFORCEMENT DIVISION ACT OF 2026; PROVIDING FOR CONSIDERATION OF H.R. 10326, PREVENTING RIP-OFFS AND OBTAINING OVERSIGHT OF FUNDS ACT...
sentences: I rise in support of this rule, which would allow the House to consider two important pieces of legislation that improve the Federal Government's ability to combat taxpayer fraud.
If we have to do it on our own, we will, Mr. Speaker, because that is what we are about.
We have introduced legislation to establish an overpayment czar to help State-level fraud prevention.
Mr. Speaker, I urge my colleagues to support this rule.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: GUARDING UNPROTECTED AGING RETIREES FROM DECEPTION ACT OF 2026
statements.title: GUARDING UNPROTECTED AGING RETIREES FROM DECEPTION ACT OF 2026
sentences: As part of our work, we conducted many hearings, roundtables, meetings with private industry, law enforcement, and regulators to investigate the problem and find solutions.
The important legislation addresses many of the issues we identified in equipping law enforcement with the tools necessary to combat sophisticated criminals.
It also allows law enforcement to use innovative tools to trace and recover stolen funds and improves Federal reporting on fraud trends.
Mr. Speaker, I strongly support H.R. 2978, the GUARD Act.
Mr. Speaker, I urge and thank my colleagues on the other side of the aisle for their support.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: MAIN STREET CAPITAL ACCESS ACT
statements.title: MAIN STREET CAPITAL ACCESS ACT
sentences: This legislation supports community banks, protects Main Street across the country, and I urge support.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: TAKE CARE OF AMERICA'S VETERANS ACT
statements.title: TAKE CARE OF AMERICA'S VETERANS ACT
sentences: They have earned a Department of Veterans Affairs that delivers the care, benefits, and support that they were promised without unnecessary delays or bureaucratic obstacles, and that includes community care, Mr. Speaker.
That is one of the aversions and obstacles and reasons for opposition because Democrats are pretty much against community care initiatives.
It also strengthens access to community care, as mentioned, and mental health treatment.
Mr. Speaker, I rise today in support of the Take Care of America's Veterans Act.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: MOMENT OF SILENCE HONORING MICHAEL PAHIRA
statements.title: MOMENT OF SILENCE HONORING MICHAEL PAHIRA
sentences: After attending East Stroudsburg University, Michael answered the call of service and entered the Pennsylvania State Police Academy, graduating in 2007 as a proud member of 124th Cadet Class of Pennsylvania State Troopers.

I attended the funeral service for Trooper Pahira last week alongside his parents, Michael Sr. and Patricia; his sister, Jennifer; and thousands of community members; fellow police officers; friends, and law enforcement from throughout the State who gathered to honor his legacy.

We can honor the memory of Trooper Pahira and show more respect for the men and women of law enforcement and the communities they serve by implementing some commonsense legislation that can prevent such senseless tragedies from happening again.
Bon was in the country illegally, ordered to deport, did not do so, and was operating a commercial vehicle with a nondomiciled commercial driver's license issued by the Commonwealth of Massachusetts.

I am calling on every Member of Congress to support Dalilah's Law to bring common sense and strength in commercial driver's license requirements, ensuring those with commercial driver's licenses can read English and are in the United States with legal status.
It is our duty to do all we can to provide such safety for law enforcement and everyone on America's roadways.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: CONDEMNING ACTORS SEEKING TO DEFRAUD THE UNITED STATES GOVERNMENT, AND EXPRESSING THE SENSE OF THE HOUSE OF REPRESENTATIVES THAT GOVERNMENTWIDE FRAUD AND IMPROPER P
statements.title: CONDEMNING ACTORS SEEKING TO DEFRAUD THE UNITED STATES GOVERNMENT, AND EXPRESSING THE SENSE OF THE HOUSE OF REPRESENTATIVES THAT GOVERNMENTWIDE FRAUD AND IMPROPER PAYMENT PREVENTION REFORMS WILL...
sentences: Mr. Speaker, as Chairman of the Financial Services Oversight and Investigations Subcommittee, I have worked with banks, telecom companies, regulators, law enforcement, and consumer groups to fight fraud and scams.
Mr. Speaker, I rise in support of Representative Fallon's antifraud resolution, H. Res. 1335.
I urge passage and yield back.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: PROVIDING FOR THE CONCURRENCE BY THE HOUSE IN THE SENATE AMENDMENT TO H.R. 6644, WITH AMENDMENT
statements.title: PROVIDING FOR THE CONCURRENCE BY THE HOUSE IN THE SENATE AMENDMENT TO H.R. 6644, WITH AMENDMENT
sentences: We have a housing supply program.
Homebuilders tell us their costs are nearly $100,000 before a shovel even hits the dirt due to overregulation, permitting, environmental reviews, and zoning delays.
It modernizes zoning guidance to create new housing developments, speeds up environmental and project reviews that too often delay construction for months, if not years, and increase costs.

President Trump and Republicans in Congress and, clearly, many Democrats are determined to address our housing challenges, including preventing institutional investors from owning single-family homes, which is, again, very important.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: THANKING LAW ENFORCEMENT
statements.title: THANKING LAW ENFORCEMENT
sentences: During National Police Week, police officers, detectives, State troopers, police chiefs, and sheriffs are traveling to Washington to acknowledge the contributions of their fellow men and women in uniform.
As the son of a police officer, I do know firsthand the experiences that law enforcement and their families face every day and the dangers.
In 2022, Lieutenant William Lebo of the Lebanon City Police Department right in the middle of my district was shot and killed in the line of duty.
These tragedies underscore the need to always back the blue and why I advocated renaming a Lebanon County post office with the House's support in Lieutenant Lebo's honor.
To commemorate all the fallen heroes, last Police Week the House passed my resolution, the Gold Shield Families Resolution.
I call on all Americans to join me in thanking law enforcement by never failing in our duty to back the blue. ____________________

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: PROVIDING FOR DISPOSITION OF SENATE AMENDMENT TO H.R. 7147, DEPARTMENT OF HOMELAND SECURITY APPROPRIATIONS ACT, 2026
statements.title: PROVIDING FOR DISPOSITION OF SENATE AMENDMENT TO H.R. 7147, DEPARTMENT OF HOMELAND SECURITY APPROPRIATIONS ACT, 2026
sentences: The fact is that the Democrat leadership, over a 4-year period, let millions and millions and millions of illegal aliens and illegal persons into our country and, along with it, tons of drugs and all kinds of human trafficking.
It sets border security operations and CBP at zero quite intentionally.
Zero dollars means that day-to-day operations at Customs and Border Protection are not funded.
That is explicitly attempting to open our southern border.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: CRACKDOWN ON WASTE, ABUSE, AND FRAUD
statements.title: CRACKDOWN ON WASTE, ABUSE, AND FRAUD
sentences: I plan to work with the task force to protect taxpayers and work to drain the swamp. ____________________

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: DIRECTING THE PRESIDENT PURSUANT TO SECTION 5(C) OF THE WAR POWERS RESOLUTION TO REMOVE UNITED STATES ARMED FORCES FROM UNAUTHORIZED HOSTILITIES IN THE ISLAMIC REPU
statements.title: DIRECTING THE PRESIDENT PURSUANT TO SECTION 5(C) OF THE WAR POWERS RESOLUTION TO REMOVE UNITED STATES ARMED FORCES FROM UNAUTHORIZED HOSTILITIES IN THE ISLAMIC REPUBLIC OF IRAN
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I rise in opposition to H. Con. Res. 38 which would limit the President's ability to protect the American people from Iran's terrorist regime.
Today, Iran is an island thanks to the strategy of the Trump administration.
The Iran of the past, one that oppresses and commits terrorism and all kinds of atrocities on its own people and the world, is history.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: HOUSING FOR THE 21ST CENTURY
statements.title: HOUSING FOR THE 21ST CENTURY
sentences: Housing affordability is a supply problem, and for too long, Federal policy has made it slow and expensive to build new homes.
This legislation builds on that progress by removing Federal barriers so homes can be built faster and economically at scale without new Federal spending.

Mr. Speaker, I rise in support of the Housing for the 21st Century Act, introduced by Chairman Hill and Subcommittee on Housing and Insurance Chairman Flood, which passed the House with overwhelming bipartisan support.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: INCREASING INVESTOR OPPORTUNITIES ACT
statements.title: INCREASING INVESTOR OPPORTUNITIES ACT
sentences: Mr. Chairman, I thank Chairwoman Wagner for her leadership and, with all due respect to our minority leader, I oppose this amendment.
The INVEST Act is a major win for workers, entrepreneurs, and small businesses, and I support its passage.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: INVESTING IN ALL OF AMERICA ACT OF 2025
statements.title: INVESTING IN ALL OF AMERICA ACT OF 2025
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I rise in support of my legislation, H.R. 2066, the Investing in All of America Act of 2025.

The Investing in All of America Act encourages additional private capital investments in parts of America that are often overlooked by not counting dollars invested in these areas against an individual SBIC's $175 million leverage cap.
The Trump administration and SBA Administrator Kelly Loeffler are focused on fueling small business growth and reinvigorating domestic manufacturing throughout the United States.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: CONTINUING APPROPRIATIONS AND EXTENSIONS ACT, 2026
statements.title: CONTINUING APPROPRIATIONS AND EXTENSIONS ACT, 2026
sentences: The only thing that is not fiction, however, is their consistent criticism of the healthcare system known as ObamaCare that they created.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: NEVER FORGET SEPTEMBER 11
statements.title: NEVER FORGET SEPTEMBER 11
sentences: Yet even in that moment of national grief, I will always remember the New York streets lined with Americans cheering for first responders and standing together in renewed patriotism.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: FAILED SOCIAL EXPERIMENT BACKFIRING ON OUR COMMUNITIES
statements.title: FAILED SOCIAL EXPERIMENT BACKFIRING ON OUR COMMUNITIES
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I, too, rise today in regard to the latest stabbing on the Charlotte Area Transit System of Iryna Zarutska.
Despite this record, mental health issues, and skipping bond, a Democrat judge--happened to be Democrat--released him back into the streets after his arrest in January.
Police do their jobs, but ideological prosecutors and judges refuse to do theirs.
In D.C., police recently arrested a carjacking suspect who laughed in their faces saying: I have been in the D.C. jail six times for this warrant.
I will be out tomorrow because the victims never show up.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: GUIDING AND ESTABLISHING NATIONAL INNOVATION FOR U.S. STABLECOINS ACT
statements.title: GUIDING AND ESTABLISHING NATIONAL INNOVATION FOR U.S. STABLECOINS ACT
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I rise today in strong support of S. 1582, the GENIUS Act.
Mr. Speaker, the Senate's legislation built on 2 years of groundwork by the House, crafting a framework for stablecoins that protects consumers, the dollar, and unleashes private-sector innovation.
It supports the dollar's role as the world's reserve currency.
Mr. Speaker, I urge my colleagues to support it.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: ANTI-CBDC SURVEILLANCE STATE ACT
statements.title: ANTI-CBDC SURVEILLANCE STATE ACT
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I rise in support of H.R. 1919, the Anti-CBDC Surveillance State Act, led by Whip Emmer.
It is a foundational element of our constitutional Republic designed to keep such important authority over our Nation's currency issuance within the hands of the people's Representatives.
A central bank digital currency would centralize unprecedented power in the Federal Government and could open the door to real-time surveillance of every financial transaction in America.
A CBDC could undo that protection overnight, creating a tool ripe for abuse.

Even though the Constitution is clear, this bill restrains the Fed from even considering a central bank digital currency, reinforces Congress' constitutional authority over currency, and ensures that any digital dollar reflects our founding principles.
Mr. Speaker, I commend Whip Emmer for his leadership, and I urge support for this very important legislation.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: RELATING TO CONSIDERATION OF THE SENATE AMENDMENT TO H.R. 4, RESCISSIONS ACT OF 2025
statements.title: RELATING TO CONSIDERATION OF THE SENATE AMENDMENT TO H.R. 4, RESCISSIONS ACT OF 2025
sentences: Mr. Speaker, let's set something straight about tax cuts, so-called, for billionaires.
There are fewer than 800 billionaires in the United States of America.
As a matter of fact, Mr. Speaker, most of those billionaires--over 70 percent--are huge Democratic donors.
Service on the debt alone increased during that time from $400 billion in 2020 to nearly $1 trillion last year.
USAID has done some good things, but they have also done things that were an enormous waste, totally inappropriate, and, in fact, they lost the trust of the American people.
Unless we want to pass along $37 trillion, and climbing, of debt to our children, we have to start spending money on the must-haves, not on the nice-to-haves.
Mr. Speaker, let's pass this rescissions package.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: AMERICAN ECONOMY GAINING MOMENTUM
statements.title: AMERICAN ECONOMY GAINING MOMENTUM
sentences: After 4 years of inflation caused by excessive government spending and an all-out assault on U.S. energy, our private-sector economy is now in significant recovery, and it truly is only the beginning.
Tariffs are realigning supply chains here at home.
Mr. Speaker, a 1 percent reduction of interest rates to 3.5 percent would add $290 billion in GDP growth while also delivering $200 billion of savings in the service we pay on our debt.

This supports President Trump's initiative to end veteran homelessness through the Bridging Rental Assistance for Veteran Empowerment program, protects veterans' Second Amendment rights, and invests heavily in general military construction.

Continue Building World's Strongest Military Mr. Speaker, I rise today as we are voting on the fiscal 2026 Military Construction, Veterans Affairs, and Related Agencies Appropriations Act, an essential bill that demonstrates our unwavering commitment to our veterans, military families, and national security.
This is a major piece of legislation, totaling $453 billion, that ensures we support those who have worn the uniform and continue building the strongest military in the world.
This bill fully funds veterans' medical care, backing up the words we often say on this floor and throughout our districts that we support our veterans and thank them for their service.
Mr. Speaker, I urge my colleagues to vote ``yes'' on this critical appropriations bill.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: RESCISSIONS ACT OF 2025
statements.title: RESCISSIONS ACT OF 2025
sentences: Even after COVID, the Biden administration accelerated the deficit with unchecked spending, causing the deficit to double, which increased service on the debt from $400 billion in 2019 to nearly $1 trillion last year.
Maybe USAID has done some good things, but they have also done many things that were totally inappropriate.
Mr. Speaker, let's pass this rescissions package, codify President Trump's spending reductions into law, and save our country along the way.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: 7(a) LOAN AGENT OVERSIGHT ACT
statements.title: 7(a) LOAN AGENT OVERSIGHT ACT
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I urge the passage of my bill.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: PROVIDING FOR CONSIDERATION OF H.R. 1, ONE BIG BEAUTIFUL BILL ACT
statements.title: PROVIDING FOR CONSIDERATION OF H.R. 1, ONE BIG BEAUTIFUL BILL ACT
sentences: It is designed to strengthen our national security, fortify our now-secure border, which was turned into a disaster by the Democrats, responsibly grow our domestic energy supply, and create more opportunity for Americans.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: CALLING UPON LOCAL COMMUNITIES TO SUPPORT ORGANIZATIONS THAT PROVIDE RESOURCES AND AID GOLD SHIELD FAMILIES IN THEIR TIME OF NEED
statements.title: CALLING UPON LOCAL COMMUNITIES TO SUPPORT ORGANIZATIONS THAT PROVIDE RESOURCES AND AID GOLD SHIELD FAMILIES IN THEIR TIME OF NEED
sentences: Mr. Speaker, this is National Police Week, and I rise in support of my legislation, H. Res. 364, the Gold Shield families resolution.
Police officers, firefighters, EMTs, correctional officers, and dispatchers are the tip of the proverbial spear.
My father was a police officer and a detective, while my grandfather also was a firefighter.
I remember well what it meant to be a police family, and I know the courage it takes not just for the officer but for the family members who stand behind them.
During National Police Week, let me say this to every police officer, firefighter, EMT, dispatcher, and emergency responder: I thank them for their service.
Mr. Speaker, I urge my colleagues to support H. Res. 364.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: NATIONAL SMALL BUSINESS WEEK
statements.title: NATIONAL SMALL BUSINESS WEEK
sentences: Throughout my district and Pennsylvania, from Schuylkill County to Wyoming County, to the Susquehanna Valley to Lebanon, from Luzerne to Lycoming, these chambers are working every day to support job creators and bring small businesses together.

I introduced the Investing in All of America Act, which expands access to capital for small manufacturers and startups in economically underserved and rural areas by raising the leverage cap on small business investment companies.

Finally, through reconciliation--also known as the one big, beautiful bill--we are committed to extending the provisions of President Trump's Tax Cuts and Jobs Act, which helped countless small businesses invest, expand, and hire.
If my Democratic colleagues oppose this bill, they are voting in favor of the largest tax increase on working families in American history, plain and simple.
The Regulatory Review Improvement Act, which I also introduced, ensures that Federal agencies take into account the real-world impact of their rules on small businesses.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: PROTECTING THE RIGHTS OF AMERICAN CITIZENS TO VOTE
statements.title: PROTECTING THE RIGHTS OF AMERICAN CITIZENS TO VOTE
sentences: Mr. Speaker, this morning, all 216 of my GOP colleagues, along with just four out of 212 Democrats, passed the SAVE Act, which is a bill that mandates proof of citizenship for those registering to vote.
Even though it is in the Constitution and Federal law mandates that only citizens can vote, there are States that have systems in place that allow noncitizens to register.
To address this problem, the SAVE Act also requires States to establish a program to remove noncitizens from their voter rolls.
Just last month, even though Iowa did what it could to correct this problem, 277 noncitizens were on the voter rolls and 35 of them voted.
The votes against the SAVE Act today were nothing more than to allow noncitizens to vote in the United States of America.
All I know, Mr. Speaker, is a vote against the SAVE Act today was a vote against American citizens' voting rights. ____________________

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: CONCURRENT RESOLUTION ON THE BUDGET FOR FISCAL YEAR 2025
statements.title: CONCURRENT RESOLUTION ON THE BUDGET FOR FISCAL YEAR 2025
sentences: Mr. Speaker, in order for us to deliver one big, beautiful reconciliation bill, one that extends the provisions of the Tax Cuts and Jobs Act, reins in regulations of wasteful spending, unleashes American energy, secures the border, curbs inflation, and restores American growth and competitiveness, we first must pass the budget resolution.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: ADVANCING AMERICA FIRST POLICIES
statements.title: ADVANCING AMERICA FIRST POLICIES
sentences: If we truly want to improve student outcomes, we must embrace school choice and voucher programs, something my home State Governor's office in Pennsylvania still refuses to do.
School choice States have flourished.
President Trump recognizes the importance of school choice, issuing an executive order directing the Department of Education to guide States on how to use Federal funds for K-12 scholarship programs.
It also instructs the Education Secretary to prioritize school choice when awarding discretionary grants.

To that end, I am pleased to support H.R. 833, the Educational Choice for Children Act, which offers a Federal tax credit to encourage charitable donations toward scholarships that help families cover K-12 expenses, tuition, books, supplies, and more.
School choice works, Mr. Speaker, and what are these politicians afraid of?

The executive orders returning education authority to the States not only prioritizes school choice, it also ensures that vital services and benefits continue without disruption during the transition.
We cannot allow the status quo to be accepted.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: CONTINUING RESOLUTION SETS STAGE FOR NEW GOLDEN AGE
statements.title: CONTINUING RESOLUTION SETS STAGE FOR NEW GOLDEN AGE
sentences: Despite many false claims, the continuing resolution we just passed does not cut Medicaid, Medicare, Social Security, or veterans benefits or any healthcare benefits at all.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: ONE BIG, BEAUTIFUL BILL
statements.title: ONE BIG, BEAUTIFUL BILL
sentences: This bill is going to deliver dominant energy policy and border security, stopping human trafficking and the rampant drug flow that is occurring.
Despite this, the media and the left want to malign this resolution, stating, for instance, that Medicaid is going to be reduced.
Let me say it from the not-so-cheap seats: No Medicaid or Medicare benefits will be reduced.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: FIGHTING TO SECURE OUR BORDER
statements.title: FIGHTING TO SECURE OUR BORDER
sentences: Despite this decrease, the threat from illegal immigration has not evaporated.

H.R. 35, the Agent Raul Gonzalez Officer Safety Act, passed just a few minutes ago, gives law enforcement authorities the necessary tools to fully penalize criminals who intentionally evade border security agents.
Penalties include jail time and a permanent ban on obtaining legal status.
This legislation does send a clear message to cartels and traffickers: If you endanger Americans lives, we will hold you accountable.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: CHINA EXCHANGE RATE TRANSPARENCY ACT OF 2025
statements.title: CHINA EXCHANGE RATE TRANSPARENCY ACT OF 2025
sentences: This legislation directly confronts the People's Republic of China's very nebulous, opaque, and often manipulative practices in foreign exchange markets, including their policy of intentionally depreciating their own currency, which undercuts the competitiveness of U.S. exports in a random manner that is targeted based upon products in particular industries.
Mr. Speaker, I rise in support of my legislation, the China Exchange Rate Transparency Act, H.R. 692, a bipartisan bill supported by my colleagues on both sides of the aisle.

By mandating the U.S. Executive Director at the International Monetary Fund to use the voice and vote of the United States to advocate for increased exchange rate transparency from China, we are not just advocating for fairness; we are fighting for the integrity of the global economy in line with our own international trade goals.
I strongly urge my colleagues to support the China Exchange Rate Transparency Act, H.R. 692, which did pass overwhelmingly last Congress by a vote of 379-1.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: PROTECT SMALL BUSINESSES FROM EXCESSIVE PAPERWORK ACT OF 2025
statements.title: PROTECT SMALL BUSINESSES FROM EXCESSIVE PAPERWORK ACT OF 2025
sentences: Republicans received a mandate to cut the red tape and push back against unnecessary, punitive regulations--and we are going to do it-- that do more harm than good.
Mr. Speaker, I urge my colleagues to support this legislation.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: VOTE FOR CLEAN ENERGY
statements.title: VOTE FOR CLEAN ENERGY
sentences: It ensures that no President can unilaterally ban hydraulic fracturing by natural gas and oil, protecting one of America's most vital energy resources from being shut down by ideological policies.
Mr. Speaker, the entire world is fracking, but we do it best and cleanest here in the USA.
I urge my colleagues to vote for clean energy and for American economic and national security strength by supporting this legislation which we are voting on tomorrow. ____________________
Mr. Speaker, I rise in support of the Protecting Energy Production Act.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: REPUBLICANS STAND WITH WOMEN
statements.title: REPUBLICANS STAND WITH WOMEN
sentences: Mr. Speaker, this past week, House Republicans passed the Protection of Women and Girls in Sports Act, which ensures that biological men cannot compete in women's and girls' sports.
Also, it is not acceptable to force women to share a locker room with a biological man, forcing them to shower and change together.
It is happening, and it is traumatizing to women and girls to have a man walking around naked in their locker room or spiking a volleyball full force into their face.
